from __future__ import annotations
import json, urllib.request

with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/snapshot", timeout=8) as r:
    d=json.loads(r.read().decode())
states={"RUNNING","STARTED","CLAIMED","DISPATCHED","INFLIGHT","CONTINUE_QUEUED","CONTINUE_SENT","PENDING"}
tasks=d.get("tasks") or []
bad=[str(x.get("status") or "") for x in tasks if str(x.get("status") or "").upper() not in states]
counts=d.get("counts") or {}
gs=d.get("git_sync") or {}
print(
    "CC_SHORT "
    f"GS={gs.get('status')} "
    f"COUNT={counts.get('tasks')} "
    f"LEN={len(tasks)} "
    f"BAD={','.join(bad[:3]) or '-'} "
    f"ALERTS={len(d.get('chain_alerts') or [])} "
    f"ISSUE={(gs.get('issues') or ['-'])[0][:160]}",
    flush=True,
)
raise SystemExit(17)
